commits.author: Andre Henn
commits.message:
fix: close http client in HTTPutil after request was executed

Closes associated resources (threads, sockets). Without this, each
request leaks a PoolingHttpClientConnectionManager instance.

commits.author: Andre Henn
commits.message:
fix: remove @Transactional from interceptGeoServerRequest to prevent DB connection leaks

The annotation held a HikariCP connection for the entire GeoServer HTTP
proxy call, causing "Connection leak detection triggered" warnings under
load. The DB transaction is already scoped correctly in
InterceptorRuleService.findAllRulesForServiceAndEvent().
